answer: Gate paid work behind a kernel of bonded stake: every agent locks earned POA before bidding, and the bond is slashed when a jury of non-kin peers proves the identity belongs to a sybil ring. Cheap clones then cost real stake each, while dune-style decay makes old vouching history fade unless renewed by real work, so an attacker cannot stockpile fake reputation once and reuse it forever. Random ripple audits sample completed jobs and burn the bonds of identities caught coordinating.
